# IInstitutionalVaultRegistryEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IInstitutionalVaultRegistryEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IInstitutionalVaultRegistryEvents

Events for the Institutional Vault Registry


## Events
### InstitutionAdded
Emitted when a new institution is added


```solidity
event InstitutionAdded(
    bytes32 indexed id, address configurationManager, address protocolAccessManager, address admiralsQuarters
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`id`|`bytes32`|The id of the institution|
|`configurationManager`|`address`||
|`protocolAccessManager`|`address`||
|`admiralsQuarters`|`address`||

### InstitutionRemoved
Emitted when an institution is disabled


```solidity
event InstitutionRemoved(bytes32 indexed id);
```

### InstitutionAdmiralsQuartersUpdated
Emitted when an institution's AdmiralsQuarters address is updated


```solidity
event InstitutionAdmiralsQuartersUpdated(
    bytes32 indexed id, address previousAdmiralsQuarters, address newAdmiralsQuarters
);
```

### InstitutionReplaced
Emitted when an institution is replaced with a new one


```solidity
event InstitutionReplaced(bytes32 indexed oldId, bytes32 indexed newId);
```
